引.meaning: Next to the <part>bow</part> stands a <part>pole</part>: the arrow, ready to go. You hook it on the string and <kanji>pull</kanji> it back as far as it will stretch, arms shaking.
引.on: The arrow's tip was dipped in a pot of <sound>in</sound>k, and it leaves a black line on your cheek.
引.kun: You pull so hard on the string that you get the hiccups: '<sound>Hee</sound>-<sound>koo</sound>!'

値.meaning: At the tailor's, a jacket hangs on a <part>coat hook</part>, and the tailor lays a long <part>straight</part> ruler along each sleeve. Every inch of cloth costs a coin. Long arms, high <kanji>price</kanji>.
値.on: A <sound>chee</sound>tah snatches the price tag and sprints off with it.
値.kun: The price tag ends up hanging on the tailor's necktie. '<sound>Ah</sound>! <sound>Tie</sound>!'

身.meaning: A body seen from the side: a head on top, ribs as lines across the middle, one leg stepping out at the bottom and an arm swinging. Nobody in particular, just a body walking by: <kanji>somebody</kanji>.
身.on: Somebody walking by isn't looking and kicks you right in the <sound>shin</sound>.
身.kun: A <sound>mee</sound>rkat stands up straight on its hind legs, looking like somebody.

薬.meaning: Under a cap of <part>grass</part>, a tiny drum kit on a tree stand plays <part>music</part>, and herbs sprout out of the drums. The herbalist plucks one, grinds it into a pill and hands it to you: <kanji>medicine</kanji>, the kind that makes you dance.
薬.on: The herbalist grows the medicine on a spiky <sound>yuc</sound>ca plant and snaps off a leaf for you.
薬.kun: The <sound>cu</sound>ckoo washes its pill down with <sound>su</sound>shi on a coral <sound>ree</sound>f.

高.meaning: A tower: a <part>lid</part> of a roof, a <part>mouth</part> window, then a big <part>TV set</part> of a ground floor glowing out at the street. Stack floors like that, one on another, and it gets <kanji>tall</kanji>.
高.on: On the very top sits a giant ice cream <sound>co</sound>ne sign you can see from anywhere.
高.kun: You carry a <sound>tu</sound>b with a <sound>ca</sound>rp in it all the way up and set it on the roof.

価.meaning: A crate from the <part>west</part>, bought dirt cheap, hangs on a <part>coat hook</part> by the door. Someone opens it and everyone gasps: it's worth a fortune here. Same crate, a new <kanji>value</kanji>.
価.on: The crate turns out to be full of <sound>ca</sound>rp, and they sell for gold.
価.kun: Like a price tag, the crate's value hangs on a necktie: '<sound>Ah</sound>! <sound>Tie</sound>!'

便.meaning: A tiny shop with a <part>coat hook</part> by the door for your wet umbrella, and a <part>night watch</part> guard who keeps it open all night long. Glue, snacks, batteries, any hour, a step from home: pure <kanji>convenience</kanji>.
便.on: There's even a rubbish <sound>bin</sound> right by the door, so you don't have to walk far.
便.kun: '<sound>Tah</sound>-dah!' says the clerk, and hands you a letter tucked under the last pot of <sound>yo</sound>gurt, on a shelf shaped like a coral <sound>ree</sound>f.
